title: Normalized ordinary tensor comparison data
statement: For small sites $(C,J),(D,K)$, commutative ring sheaves $R$ on $C$ and $RI,S$ on $D$, an algebraic inverse-image presentation $I$ of $uInv$ [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], $c:RI\to S$, and a module functor $L$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with specified object equalities $L(M)=S\otimes_{RI}I(M)$, a CanonicalRingedTensorComparison consists of the scalar-extension insertion $q$, with q_one sending $m$ to the sheafification of $1\otimes m$, natural isomorphisms $\mu:L(M\otimes_R N)\cong L(M)\otimes_S L(N)$, and the generalized pure-tensor equation. For every test sheaf $Z$ and maps $x:Z\to |M|$, $y:Z\to |N|$, $z:Z\to |M\otimes_R N|$ satisfying $z(t)=x(t)\otimes y(t)$, $\mu$ after $q$ sends $uInv(z)$ to the tensor of the two $q$-images. All tensors and insertions use the existing sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. This is the unchanged structure formerly declared in the parent module.
